title: Install the native compiler tools
description: Recorded in a disposable Ubuntu container running as root. For the native route, use the tutorial sudo command on your own host. Versions and package logs are sample output.

commands: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq flex bison gcc make

markers.title: Refresh the package index
markers.note: The package manager reads the Ubuntu package index in this disposable container.

markers.title: Install the toolchain
markers.note: Install Flex, Bison, GCC and Make. The tutorial native route uses sudo on your host.

markers.title: Verify the tools
markers.note: Version strings are sample output and can differ on your machine.
